findings.title: Liquidated damages calculated on contract value without client-delay exclusion
findings.deviation: Clause 12.2 calculates liquidated damages at 1% of total Contract Value per week (capped at 10% of total Contract Value under Clause 12.3), rather than 0.5% of the affected milestone fee (capped at 5% of that milestone fee), and excludes delay liability only for Force Majeure without excluding client-caused delay.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces financial penalties calculated against total contract value for delays, including those caused by client actions.
findings.quote: Should the Service Provider fail to achieve any Milestone by its scheduled completion date, the Service Provider shall pay to the Company, by way of liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to one percent (1%) of the Contract Value for each week or part thereof of delay.
findings.counterPosition: Limit delay penalties to 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week, capped at 5% of that milestone fee, explicitly exclude penalties for client-caused delay, and clarify that liquidated damages are the sole remedy for delay.

findings.title: Data protection carved out of aggregate liability cap
findings.deviation: Clause 10.2 excludes Clause 13 (Data Protection) from the aggregate liability cap of 1x Contract Value, leaving data protection liability uncapped.
findings.impact: AtliQ faces unlimited financial exposure for data protection incidents.
findings.quote: Save in respect of liability arising from fraud, wilful misconduct, breach of Clause 7 (Confidentiality) or Clause 13 (Data Protection), each Party's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the Contract Value.
findings.counterPosition: Remove Clause 13 (Data Protection) from the unlimited carve-outs and cap data protection liability under a separate super-cap (e.g., 2× fees).

findings.title: Convenience termination limits payment to accepted deliverables only
findings.deviation: Clause 6.3 states that upon convenience termination by the Company, payment is restricted to Services performed and accepted, excluding unaccepted work in progress.
findings.impact: AtliQ risks performing work without compensation if the agreement is terminated before formal milestone acceptance.
findings.quote: The Company may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' written notice, in which event the Company shall pay for all Services performed and accepted up to the date of termination.
findings.counterPosition: Require payment for all Services performed up to termination, including work in progress and committed costs.

fine.note: IP terms match standard: client owns custom deliverables upon payment, AtliQ retains background IP with a non-exclusive licence.
Indemnification is narrow and limited to IP infringement for deliverables and client-supplied materials, which is favorable to AtliQ.
Confidentiality obligations are mutual with a standard 5-year post-termination duration.
Service standards and 90-day warranty on deliverables meet AtliQ's standard.
No restrictive covenants or non-competes are imposed.
